subject.title: Bound plugin bundle command file reads with size cap

question: Should installed plugin bundle command Markdown files above 1 MiB become unsupported and be skipped with a warning on upgrade?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and observable, but selecting a permanent compatibility limit for existing user-installed plugin content is a product and upgrade-contract decision.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB contract
options.body: Merge with the current warning-and-continue behavior, treating command files above 1 MiB as unsupported installed bundle content.

options.title: Choose a different compatibility boundary
options.body: Specify a different cap or compatibility treatment, then update the constant and focused boundary proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the 1 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Merge with the current warning-and-continue behavior, treating command files above 1 MiB as unsupported installed bundle content.
